description: Tasks layer via aweb: assignment, claims, status, blockers and handoff using the instance messaging identity.

requires.why: aw >= 1.36.33: task and work commands using the instance's oats.aweb identity

team.description: The aweb team label whose task list this capability reads and writes, set only in the workspace's or a soul's tasks: payload. Absent (the default) means the home's default team. A label is a letter or digit, then up to 63 letters, digits, - or _. Every task command then runs as aw --identity-home <H>, H being joined[].identityHome for that label in oats aweb teams --json; readiness refuses a home that has not joined it, and a GLOBAL seat (#60). The default team's own label needs no join.
